rappel_detail.anchor: natural anchor: slung horn or chockstone, or a picket or deadman in snow
rappel_detail.station: The top of the short low-5th-class rock step that clears the bergschrund near the base of the route, reached by downclimbing the 40-55° snow and ice slope from the summit.
rappel_detail.notes: The one rappel, about 30 m on a doubled 60 m rope, past the bergschrund back onto the glacier. Early in the season the step can be downclimbed; by mid to late season the schrund has usually opened and parties rappel it.

set.rappels: One rappel of about 30 m (a doubled 60 m rope) over the rock step past the bergschrund, usually needed from mid-season on
